program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); let motionState = "Rising"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = "Falling"; } if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } if (t === 0) { motionState = "Ready to toss"; } const laneObjectsLeft = sdk.panel({ x: 20, y: 40, w: 280, h: 330, title: "The Motion", state: motionState }); const axisLeft = sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 50, y: 330, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const ballY = 330 - (height / 2.2) * 260; const ballObj = sdk.circle("ball.toss", 140, ballY, 24, { role: "output" }); const vecV = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: 170, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" }); const vecA = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: 195, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "a" }); const callout = sdk.callout(210, ballY - 30, [`v: ${velocity.toFixed(2)} m/s`, `a: ${acceleration.toFixed(2)} m/s^2`, `Fg: ${force.toFixed(1)} N`], { id: "callout.toss" }); const laneObjectsRight = sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 40, w: 300, h: 330, title: "Velocity over Time", state: `t = ${t.toFixed(2)} s` }); const points = sdk.sample((ti) => launchSpeed - gravity * ti, 0, 1.666666, 20); const plotObj = sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: 340, y: 80, w: 260, h: 220, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.67, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.map(([xt, yt]) => ({ x: xt, y: yt })) }], marker: { x: t, y: velocity, label: "t" } }); const plotNote = sdk.text("plot.vt.note", 350, 315, "slope a = -g", { align: "start" }); const objects = [...laneObjectsLeft, axisLeft, ballObj, ...vecV, ...vecA, ...callout, ...laneObjectsRight, plotObj, plotNote]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but the velocity-time slope stays -g. Gravity's force is F = mg: more mass means more force, with the same acceleration.
manifest.description: An interactive simulation showing a vertically tossed ball on a height ruler alongside its velocity-time graph. Controls allow adjusting launch speed, gravity, and mass.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare the readings at each pause near the top.
